wa_mount_stuart_stuart_glacier_couloir.descent_text: Descend south via the Cascadian Couloir to Ingalls Creek and out over Longs Pass, or as planned.

wa_sherpa_glacier.descent_text: Most parties descend the same glacier back to a Mountaineer Creek camp; commonly used as the descent after climbing the Ice Cliff Glacier.

wa_south_headwall.descent_text: The route tops out very close to the true summit; descend south via the Cascadian Couloir.

wa_mount_terror_southeast_face.descent_text: Standard descent is the West Ridge gully back into Crescent Creek Basin (multiple rappels off a large chockstone), not a reversal of the East Ridge.

wa_se_ridge_aka_shield_wall.descent_text: Descend via Mount Washington's standard Class 3-4 scramble route, reversing back down to the same FR-2419/Big Creek trailhead used for the approach.

wa_old_guard_peak_southwest_route.descent_text: Reverse the snow couloir and scramble down to the Le Conte-Sentinel col camp.
